response.explanation: Counts October 2026 orders with attempt_count greater than 1 and divides by total October orders to get the share needing multiple payment attempts.
response.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN attempt_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_multi_attempt, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN attempt_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS multi_attempt_share FROM v_orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
